videos.description:
The iPhone Duo’s battery life doesn’t seem like it will last a full day of heavy use, but it’s hard to tell since battery life depends on how often you open it to use the larger screen. The Verge’s Nilay Patel and Allison Johnson put the iPhone Duo’s battery life to the test in our latest review. Read or watch the full review at the link in bio.
